name: 07632 · Englewd Clfs, NJ
findings: ZIP 07632 (Englewd Clfs) has 96 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07632 (Englewd Clfs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
